Re alleged RCE in new TG Android/Windows widgets:

The issue doesn’t exist.

No one could be hacked just by receiving a message.

You had to actively start a third-party service first.

✅ Even that is fully patched server-side.

Think otherwise? Go hack my account: t.me/monk 🍿

text:
Digital Freedom Contest: Submissions

👏 We would like to thank each contestant for their input – you are all amazing! More than 1,000 links were submitted, already drawing over 67.2M views. That is the population of a large country – reached, thanks to you, with the idea of digital freedom.

🎬 We will open all submissions on contest.com in the coming days – watch for a separate announcement here. Judging is already underway; results are expected by the end of August.

❗ If you have not yet edited your video's caption on the external platform or updated your bio (on TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube or Snap) to include your @username  or t.me/username, please do so immediately. This is the only way we can verify that you are the author of the submitted video.

Digital Freedom Contest: Submissions

👏 We would like to thank each contestant for their input – you are all amazing! More than 1,000 links were submitted, already drawing over 67.2M views. That is the population of a large country – reached, thanks to you, with the idea of digital freedom.

🎬 We will open all submissions on contest.com in the coming days – watch for a separate announcement here. Judging is already underway; results are expected by the end of August.

❗ If you have not yet edited your video's caption on the external platform or updated your bio (on TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube or Snap) to include your @username or t.me/username, please do so immediately. This is the only way we can verify that you are the author of the submitted video.
